purpose: English Godot translation for Prague Municipal Court order 8 Ad 9/2026-85 of 28 August 2026.

documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-08-28-8-ad-9-2026-85: The Prague Municipal Court rejected the intervention action against the Ministry of Health under Section 46(1)(a) of the Code of Administrative Justice, finding that the challenged classification of medicinal cannabis as a ‘highly addictive substance’ was not an individualised intervention against the claimant but part of the general statutory and regulatory framework. No party was awarded costs. After the order becomes final, the claimant is to receive a refund of the full CZK 2,000 court fee because the action was rejected before the first hearing; the Court requested bank details within 10 days. A cassation complaint may be filed within two weeks of service.
